title: Growing coral in an underwater nursery
name: Sample story
story:
This is a sample story to show how a pin looks. Imagine a group of local divers who hang coral fragments on underwater 'trees', let them grow for a season, then replant them on damaged patches of reef.

Real stories submitted through the "Share your story" button will replace these.

title: Saturday morning beach cleanups
name: Sample story
story: This is a sample story. Picture neighbours meeting every Saturday to clear plastic from the shoreline, sorting what they find so they can show the city where the waste comes from.

title: Replanting mangroves along the delta
name: Sample story
story: This is a sample story. Mangrove forests protect villages from storm surges and shelter young fish. A story here might describe a school planting seedlings along the riverbanks each monsoon.

title: Night patrols for nesting turtles
name: Sample story
story: This is a sample story. Volunteers walk the beach at night during nesting season, marking nests and keeping lights and dogs away so hatchlings can find the sea.

title: A no-take zone run by fishers
name: Sample story
story: This is a sample story. A fishing village agrees to leave one stretch of reef alone, and after a few years their catch just outside it grows.

title: Teaching kids to read the kelp forest
name: Sample story
story: This is a sample story. Snorkel lessons for local kids that double as a survey of what lives in the kelp — the kids log what they see and the data goes to researchers.

title: Watching the sea ice change
name: Sample story
story: This is a sample story. Hunters and elders compare what the ice looks like today with what they remember, and share those observations with scientists.
